name: Is insulated glass replacement available for all types of windows?

mainEntity.name: Is insulated glass replacement available for all types of windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insulated glass replacement is generally available for most common window types, including single-hung, double-hung, casement, awning, picture, and sliding windows. The key factor is whether the existing window frame is designed to accommodate an insulated glass unit and remains in good structural condition. Custom-sized IGUs can be fabricated to fit unique window openings. However, specialized or historic windows may require a more tailored approach or full sash replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insulated glass replacement is available for most window types, provided the frame is suitable; custom units can be made for unique sizes.
